root_cause.description: Lefthook 2.1.14 getHooksPathConfig uses scoped --local and --global Git queries without --includes, which return no value for an included hooksPath. Its actual hooks path resolution honors the include. The safety guard therefore permits installation, and Lefthook renames the existing pre-commit to pre-commit.old and writes its own hook while returning 0. Making its status nonfatal cannot prevent successful destructive hook replacement.
